resources.string: Could not enable — check that WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS is granted
Fire2MQTT can enable its permissions itself. Tap the button below.

Fire OS hides these toggles for sideloaded apps. Grant one permission via ADB, then return here — the app enables the rest automatically.

1. On the Fire TV: Settings > My Fire TV > Developer Options > enable ADB Debugging.
2. From a computer on the same network, run:
adb connect %1$s:5555\nadb shell pm grant dev.harrypulvirenti.fire2mqtt android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
